Bill.BriefDescription: Providing an exception to the unattended motor vehicle law for motor vehicles in eastern Washington.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to unattended motor vehicles east of the crest ofthe Cascade mountains; and amending RCW 46.61.600.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.61.600 and 1980 c 97 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) No person driving or in charge of a motor vehicle shallpermit it to stand unattended without first stopping the engine,locking the ignition, removing the key and effectively setting thebrake thereon and, when standing upon any perceptible grade, turningthe front wheels to the curb or side of the highway. (b) Subsection (1)(a) of this section does not apply to unattendedmotor vehicles east of the crest of the Cascade mountains from November15th to March 31st. (2) The most recent driver of a motor vehicle which the driver hasleft standing unattended, who learns that the vehicle has become set inmotion and has struck another vehicle or property, or has caused injuryto any person, shall comply with the requirements of: (a) RCW 46.52.010 if his vehicle strikes an unattended vehicle orproperty adjacent to a public highway; or p. 1 SB 6251 (b) RCW 46.52.020 if his vehicle causes damage to an attendedvehicle or other property or injury to any person. (3) Any person failing to comply with subsection (2)(b) of thissection shall be subject to the sanctions set forth in RCW 46.52.020.
